# oriz Play — full content

> Creative-play studio that runs entirely in your browser. 100% client-side — no upload, no signup, no tracking. Live at https://play.oriz.in

## What it is

oriz Play is a free creative-play studio that runs entirely in your web browser. Roll story dice, spin a writing-prompt roller, and play would-you-rather and this-or-that — then expand any roll into a vivid story opening with optional AI, and share the result by link. There is no backend, no account, and no API key. Every roll happens locally via Web Crypto randomness; the only network calls are the optional AI completions you trigger, routed through keyless g4f multi-provider gateways. If AI is down, the dice still roll.

## Hero

Roll a story into being. Story dice, prompt rollers, would-you-rather and this-or-that — spun in your browser, expandable by AI, shareable by link.

## Features

### Story Dice
Roll 1 to 9 categorized dice — Character, Setting, Object, Goal, Obstacle, Mood, Twist, Sense, Wildcard. Each die shows one face per roll, rendered as physical 3D-ish CSS dice with a tumble-and-settle animation. The faces combine into ingredients for a scene (for example: a weary knight, a storm-battered lighthouse, a key with no lock).

### Prompt Roller
Recombines opener, subject and turn fragments into a single-line writing prompt (for example: "Write about the last lighthouse keeper on Earth until a letter arrives.").

### Would You Rather
Impossible dilemmas presented as either/or choices to spark a story (for example: relive the same great day forever, or live every day new but forget it by night).

### This or That
Quickfire either/or picks (Mountains or Ocean, Sunrise or Sunset, Coffee or Tea, and more).

### Expand with AI
Fuse any roll into one evocative story opening (a 60-110 word paragraph) via @chirag127/oz-ai, a keyless g4f multi-provider client with automatic failover. Optional polish, not required for play.

### Fresh prompt pack
Generate five brand-new one-line writing prompts on any theme you type (AI, optional).

### Share by link
Copy the result text, or a compressed permalink (#r=... encoded with LZ-string) that reconstructs the exact roll on open. Recent rolls are kept in a local history.

### Accessible + fast
Keyboard-accessible, reduced-motion aware, WCAG-AA contrast. Zero heavy dependencies; AI libraries load only when you trigger an AI feature.

## How to use

1. Open https://play.oriz.in in any modern browser.
2. Choose a mode: Story Dice, Prompt Roller, Would You Rather, or This or That.
3. For Story Dice, set the number of dice (1-9) and the categories, then hit Roll.
4. Read the rolled ingredients, prompt, or dilemma.
5. Optionally hit "Expand with AI" to fuse the roll into a story opening.
6. Optionally generate a "Fresh prompt pack" of five prompts on any theme.
7. Copy the result text or share a compressed permalink that rebuilds the exact roll.
8. Browse your recent rolls from the local history.

## Privacy

100% client-side. No backend, no accounts, no telemetry. Every roll happens in your browser using Web Crypto randomness (with a Math.random fallback). Shared links encode only the roll in the URL fragment — never sent to any server. The only network calls are the optional AI completions you initiate, routed through g4f providers. History stays on your device.

## Tech

- Astro (static output), client-only React 19 islands, Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/vite).
- AI via @chirag127/oz-ai — a g4f multi-provider browser client, keyless, with automatic failover.
- Randomness via Web Crypto with a Math.random fallback.
- Share codec via lz-string (compressed URL fragment).
- Installable PWA (offline shell + runtime caching).
- Shared atomic @chirag127/* packages (oz-ai, oz-file, oz-tokens-base, oz-chrome) for mechanism only; the visual theme is bespoke to this site.

## FAQ

Is it free? Yes, completely free. No signup, no API key, no card.

Do you store my rolls? No. Rolls happen in your browser and history stays on your device. Nothing is uploaded.

Do I need an account? No. There is no auth on this free tool.

Do I need AI to play? No. Dice, prompts, would-you-rather and this-or-that all work with no network. AI expansion is optional polish.

Can I use it offline? The app shell is a PWA and installs/caches offline. AI expansion needs a network connection to reach a provider.

How does sharing work? A share link encodes only the roll in the URL fragment (#r=... via LZ-string). Opening it rebuilds the exact roll locally; nothing is sent to a server.
